summary: Dispatch scope was Phase 2 only: prove concat_language_eq (top-level language correctness of the existing DA.concat / mullerAccConcat Choueka flag-construction) in Cslib/Computability/Automata/DA/Concat.lean. Landed green and committed at 6e8c51ab. Before writing the proof, verified (via a concrete counterexample) that the existing concat/concatF2 construction had a genuine empty-prefix bug: it checked the post-transition M1 state for slot activation, so it could never witness da1.start in acc1 accepting the empty prefix, making concat_language_eq false as an unconditional equality. Fixed concatF2 and concat's tr field to check the pre-transition state and immediately advance the freshly-activated copy (matching ctchou/AutomataTheory's reference DA.Concat semantics exactly). concat_tr_snd/concat_tr_snd' updated to match (still rfl); concat_tr_nodup/concat_freeSlot needed no changes (activation-condition-agnostic). Added ~15 new private lemmas porting the reference's persistence (Nat.findGreatest breakpoint extraction, backward direction) and pointer-stabilization (antitone witness slot via antitone_fin_eventually, forward direction) argument to CSLib's dedup encoding, which differs structurally from the reference's per-slot recursive `next`. Cumulative with prior dispatches: Phase 1 (buchiCongr_DMA deprecation) and Phase 4 (Muller.union finite-union closure) are also COMPLETED and committed, so 3 of 6 phases are now green.

IMPORTANT: this dispatch also FIXED the `concat`/`concatF2` definitions themselves (not just added the correctness theorem) -- see the construction-bug note in the plan file's Phase 2 completion section for the exact counterexample and fix. No other file in the tree currently depends on `DA.concat`/`concatF2`/`mullerAccConcat`, so this fix is self-contained.
